hosting.provider: GitHub Pages (project site, deployed by GitHub Actions)

previewBuild.note: A single-page Spanish preview was fast-tracked ahead of the phase gates so Tony can review the Nocturno Broadcast direction on his phone. It partially covers T0-01, T0-02, T1-02, T1-03, T2-01, T2-02, T3-01..T3-03, T4-02 and T5-01; the Development Manager should verify and reconcile those tasks rather than rebuild them. Tony's approval of this preview is the pending Phase 1 human sign-off (T1-04).

phaseGatePolicy: Strict sequential phases (0 -> 5). All tasks in phase N must have passes=true before Manager increments currentPhase. Phase 1 requires explicit human visual sign-off before any Phase 2/3 feature code.
ledgerRules: Never delete tasks or weaken acceptanceCriteria.
Workers may propose status='in_review' with an evidence object; only the Development Manager may set passes=true and status='done' after verifying evidence.
Do not edit tasks outside your assigned Task ID.

phases.name: Harness & Repo Bootstrap
phases.exitGate: Repo initialized with git-tracked harness files, init.sh healthy, and verify:fast passing locally and in GitHub Actions CI.

phases.name: Brand Assets & Design Tokens/Mockups (Design-First Lock)
phases.exitGate: Brand brief and optimized media complete; static desktop/mobile mockups pass contrast and anti-slop evaluator critique; human approval recorded in docs/design/approval.md; tokens.css and .stylelintrc.json frozen.

phases.name: Architecture & Static Scaffold
phases.exitGate: Static SSG scaffold (Astro) renders with approved tokens, BaseLayout/Header/Footer and LiteYouTube facade built, content schemas frozen, and full Playwright/axe/Lighthouse harness green on stub routes.

phases.name: Feature Build via Parallel Subagents
phases.exitGate: All site sections built in disjoint git worktrees, rebased and merged cleanly into integration branch, zero Stylelint token errors, verify:fast green.

phases.name: Visual, Accessibility, SEO & Performance Verification
phases.exitGate: Independent QA Verifier returns SHIP on integrated branch: 0 horizontal overflow (375/768/1440px), 0 critical/serious axe WCAG 2.2 AA violations, Lighthouse thresholds green, bundle <=500KB, visual baselines committed.

phases.name: Free Hosting Launch & DNS Cutover
phases.exitGate: Site deployed to free static hosting (GitHub Pages), https://tonysinpauta.com live with valid TLS, post-deploy smoke and Lighthouse checks pass, owner maintenance runbook delivered.

tasks.title: Initialize repository and install tracked starter harness files
acceptanceCriteria: Git repository initialized on main branch with clean initial commit.
AGENTS.md, harness/feature-ledger.json, harness/delegation-protocol.md, harness/verification-gates.md, and harness/progress.log are committed and tracked in git.
None of AGENTS.md or harness/** appear in .gitignore.

tasks.title: Create deterministic init.sh and baseline package scripts
acceptanceCriteria: harness/init.sh installs dependencies cleanly and verifies local preview server health on an explicit port.
package.json defines dev, build, verify:fast, and verify:all scripts.
Zero paid or runtime-server dependencies are present in package.json.

tasks.title: Configure free-tier GitHub Actions verification workflow
acceptanceCriteria: Workflow runs on pull_request and push to main using ubuntu-latest.
Executes npm ci, npm run verify:fast, and uploads Playwright/Lighthouse artifacts on failure.
Initial CI check passes green.

tasks.title: Audit Tony Sin Pauta YouTube channel & promotional/social assets
acceptanceCriteria: brand-brief.md documents Tony Sin Pauta's channel positioning, language/tone, audience, visual cues (banner, avatar, thumbnails, typography), and verified official links.
asset-inventory.json catalogs every gathered or user-supplied visual asset with source URL, resolution, aspect ratio, usage role, and rights/ownership status.
Identifies any missing high-resolution brand assets that must be requested from Tony/user.

tasks.title: Optimize and normalize brand media assets and starter content datasets
acceptanceCriteria: Images converted to web-optimized AVIF/WebP with PNG/JPG fallback where needed (hero <=150KB, cards/avatars <=60KB).
Starter structured JSON/Markdown files created for channel metadata, featured videos, bio/about copy, and social/booking links.
No placeholder Lorem Ipsum copy; real channel copy or clearly tagged [NEEDS_OWNER_COPY] items documented.

tasks.title: Derive design system, frozen CSS tokens, Stylelint rules, and static mockups
acceptanceCriteria: Color palette, typography pairing, spacing scale, and layout motifs trace directly to Tony Sin Pauta's real promotional/channel visuals.
All text/background token pairings verified >=4.5:1 (body) and >=3.0:1 (large/UI) contrast.
Static HTML/CSS mockups render cleanly at 375px mobile and 1440px desktop with real media and copy.
.stylelintrc.json mechanically blocks raw colors, off-scale font sizes/weights, and unscaled spacing outside tokens.css.

tasks.title: Independent aesthetic critique and mandatory human design sign-off
acceptanceCriteria: QA Verifier renders Phase 1 mockups in Playwright (375px and 1440px), runs axe-core contrast check, and scores Design Quality, Originality, Craft, and Functionality against the anti-slop rubric.
User reviews screenshots/mockups and explicitly approves the visual direction.
docs/design/approval.md records approval date, approved mockup variant, and freezes tokens.css + .stylelintrc.json.

tasks.title: Scaffold static SSG project, BaseLayout, navigation shell, and YouTube facade
acceptanceCriteria: Astro static output configured (output: 'static', zero server adapters).
BaseLayout, responsive Header/Nav, Footer, and click-to-load LiteYouTube facade implemented strictly using tokens.css variables.
Stylelint, TypeScript check, and production static build pass with zero errors.

tasks.title: Freeze content schemas and build-time YouTube RSS feed loader
acceptanceCriteria: Typed schemas validate all content collections at build time.
Build-time YouTube channel Atom/RSS XML fetcher populates latest videos with zero API key cost and falls back cleanly to committed static JSON when offline.
site-architecture.md documents frozen contracts for Phase 3 parallel builders.

tasks.title: Wire Playwright layout/visual/axe suite and Lighthouse CI budgets
acceptanceCriteria: Playwright tests check 375px, 768px, and 1440px horizontal overflow, CLS, broken images, and @axe-core/playwright WCAG 2.2 AA tags.
Lighthouse CI configured with 3 runs and required median/pessimistic thresholds.
npm run verify:all passes end-to-end against the Phase 2 scaffold.

tasks.title: Build Home hero, featured episode spotlight, and latest videos section
acceptanceCriteria: Home page implements approved Phase 1 visual hero, subscribe/watch CTAs, and latest YouTube videos using LiteYouTube click-to-load facades.
Zero raw CSS values (Stylelint passes 100%).
Responsive layout holds cleanly at 375px, 768px, and 1440px with zero horizontal overflow.

tasks.title: Build About Tony Sin Pauta, show highlights, and social hub section/page
acceptanceCriteria: Presents creator bio, show format/themes, milestone highlights, and verified social platform links from src/content/.
Uses only approved tokens.css custom properties and semantic HTML landmarks/headings.
Passes verify:fast with zero lint, type, or build errors.

tasks.title: Build Booking, Collaborations & Contact section/page (zero-cost static)
acceptanceCriteria: Provides clear press/sponsor/booking contact flow with $0 recurring cost (mailto:/social links or free static form endpoint with progressive enhancement).
Includes accessible labels, focus states, and spam-safe behavior without paid SaaS.
Passes verify:fast with zero lint, type, or build errors.

tasks.title: Integrate Phase 3 parallel worktrees in dependency order
acceptanceCriteria: Worktrees for T3-01, T3-02, and T3-03 rebased and merged cleanly without unresolved conflicts or file-ownership violations.
Temporary worktrees pruned and verify:fast passes on the integrated branch.
Navigation links connect all implemented pages/sections with zero 404s.

tasks.title: Run independent whole-branch Playwright layout, visual regression, and axe-core WCAG 2.2 AA audit
acceptanceCriteria: Zero horizontal overflow, zero broken images/links, and CLS <=0.1 across 375px, 768px, and 1440px on every route.
Zero critical or serious @axe-core/playwright WCAG 2.2 AA violations; keyboard navigation verified.
Visual regression baselines captured on Linux CI and committed; Evaluator anti-slop rubric passes >= threshold.
QA report returns SHIP (or logs concrete defects for targeted builder fixes before re-run).

tasks.title: Verify Lighthouse CI budgets, SEO/OpenGraph/JSON-LD metadata, and static transfer budget
acceptanceCriteria: Lighthouse CI (3 runs) passes: Performance >=0.90 (median), Accessibility >=0.95 (target 1.0, pessimistic), Best Practices >=0.95 (pessimistic), SEO >=0.95 (target 1.0, pessimistic), CLS <=0.1.
Every route has unique title, meta description, canonical https://tonysinpauta.com/ URL, OpenGraph/Twitter card tags, sitemap.xml, and Person/VideoObject JSON-LD.
Initial page transfer weight <=500KB (excluding user-clicked video playback) and $0 recurring cost verified.

tasks.title: Configure automated $0 static deployment workflow (GitHub Pages)
acceptanceCriteria: Automated deployment builds and publishes dist/ to free static hosting on merge to main (GitHub Pages has no per-PR preview URLs; PRs are gated by the verify workflow instead).
Optional scheduled daily/weekly rebuild workflow documented to refresh YouTube RSS video feed for $0.
dns-launch-runbook.md documents exact apex/www DNS records, TLS settings, and rollback steps.

tasks.title: Execute tonysinpauta.com DNS cutover and SSL/HTTPS verification
acceptanceCriteria: User applies DNS records from dns-launch-runbook.md at domain registrar.
Both https://tonysinpauta.com and https://www.tonysinpauta.com resolve cleanly with valid TLS certificate and canonical redirect.

tasks.title: Run post-launch live production smoke test and deliver owner handoff guide
acceptanceCriteria: Live https://tonysinpauta.com returns HTTP 200, zero console errors, working YouTube facades, valid OpenGraph preview, and passing live Lighthouse audit.
docs/owner-maintenance-guide.md explains in plain language how to update bio/links/videos or trigger a rebuild at $0/month.
